name: IVR
tagline: International representation for inland waterway interests across Europe
hero_kpi_rationale: La participation aux congrès annuels représente l'engagement croissant de la base de membres et reflète l'influence de l'organisation dans le secteur européen de la navigation intérieure, avec 225 participants de 11 pays en 2024.

kpis.signal: Occupation quasi-pleine sur l'ensemble des actifs santé
kpis.description: Taux d'occupation contractuel des actifs immobiliers de santé
kpis.explanation: Quasi 100% occupation = caractéristique de l'immobilier santé sur long-bail (15-25 ans) avec opérateurs spécialisés.
kpis.explanation_en: Near 100% occupancy = typical for healthcare real estate on long leases (15-25 years) with specialized operators.

kpis.signal: WAULT 19 ans = visibilité long terme remarquable
kpis.description: Durée moyenne pondérée résiduelle des baux (WAULT)
kpis.explanation: Indicateur clé du risque locatif. 19 ans = visibilité cash flow exceptionnelle, parmi les plus élevés du secteur REIT européen.
kpis.explanation_en: Key tenant risk indicator. 19 years = exceptional cash flow visibility, among the highest in European REIT sector.

kpis.signal: EPS récurrent en croissance régulière, supportant le dividende
kpis.description: EPRA Earnings = résultat récurrent par action, exclut variations juste valeur
kpis.explanation: Métrique de référence sectorielle pour mesurer le cash flow distribuable d'un REIT. Aedifica paye dividende mensuel.
kpis.explanation_en: Sector reference metric to measure REIT distributable cash flow. Aedifica pays monthly dividend.

kpis.explanation: Total number of participants attending the annual IVR Congress representing member countries and organizations across Europe.
kpis.signal: Strong member engagement and international participation demonstrating organizational reach and credibility.
kpis.description: The 2024 IVR Congress in Frankfurt am Main (15-17 May) attracted 225 participants from 11 European countries, representing an increase from previous years reflecting growing sector engagement.

kpis.name_fr: Participation au Colloque de Prévention des Sinistres
kpis.explanation: Number of participants attending the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium, an event bringing together industry professionals to discuss damage prevention and risk management.
kpis.signal: Strong inaugural attendance from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany indicates market demand for specialized loss prevention knowledge sharing.
kpis.description: The first IVR Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp on 4 November 2024 attracted approximately 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany, featuring 8 presentations across 3 sessions covering technical and financial aspects of damage prevention.

kpis.explanation: Number of European countries with representation in IVR leadership, governance, and membership structures.
kpis.signal: Pan-European reach demonstrating the organization's role as a genuinely international industry representative body.
kpis.description: The 2024 annual congress brought together representatives from 11 different European countries, affirming IVR's position as a cross-border coordination platform for the inland shipping industry.

company_description: Aedifica NV/SA is a Belgian public regulated real estate company specializing in European healthcare real estate, particularly properties for elderly care. Aedifica has built a real estate portfolio worth approximately 12.4 billion euros in Belgium, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, Finland, Ireland, Spain, France, and Italy. Aedifica is listed on Euronext Brussels (2006) and Euronext Amsterdam (2019) and is identified by the following codes: AED; AED:BB (Bloomberg); AOO.BR (Reuters). Since 2020, Aedifica has been a constituent of the BEL 20, the main stock market index of Euronext Brussels. Furthermore, since 2023, Aedifica has been included in the BEL ESG, the index that tracks the best-performing companies based on ESG criteria. Aedifica is also included in the EPRA, Stoxx Europe 600, and GPR indices. Its market capitalization was approximately 5.9 billion euros as of April 1, 2026. Aedifica NV/SA was established on November 07, 2005 and incorporated in 2005 in Belgium.
